lines_zh: 梅尔丹，维里迪亚 · 3724 年霜月 7 日

lines: How much confidence do you have in the Veridian military? How much confidence do you have in the Veridian military?: None at all 39%, A little 25%, Some 15%, A lot 12%, Total confidence 9%.
How much confidence do you have in the Veridian
lines_zh: 你对维里迪亚军队有多大信心？ 你对维里迪亚军队有多大信心？：完全没有 39%，一点点 25%，有一些 15%，很大 12%，完全信任 9%。

lines: Who would you prefer to run the Veridian military? Who would you prefer to run the Veridian military?: Its current leadership 13%, A new leadership chosen by parliament 21%, Silverchat 10%, The Arctics 16%, Kungaupei 38%, Arturian military advisors 2%.
lines_zh: 你希望由谁来掌管维里迪亚军队？ 你希望由谁来掌管维里迪亚军队？：现任领导层 13%，议会选出的新领导层 21%，银聊 10%，北极人 16%，昆高派 38%，阿图莉亚军事顾问 2%。

lines: Who would you prefer to run the Veridian military? — Restricted to people with Northshore ties Who would you prefer to run the Veridian military? — Restricted to people with Northshore ties: Its current leadership 6%, A new leadership chosen by parliament 8%, Silverchat 16%, The Arctics 13%, Kungaupei 52%, Arturian military advisors 5%.
Restricted to people with Northshore ties
